description.p: Kanshi Editor is a graphical editor for kanshi, the display profile daemon for sway and other wlroots compositors. Drag displays into place, pick resolution, scale and rotation, and manage every profile, including ones for monitors that are not plugged in right now.
Your configuration file stays yours: comments and formatting are kept, and only the lines you change are rewritten.

ul.li: All profiles in one place, in the order kanshi tries them
Displays drawn to scale, with snapping while you drag
Live screen pictures and connector names tell identical monitors apart
Shows which profile kanshi is using right now
Warnings for overlapping or unreachable displays
Saves, reloads kanshi and switches profiles for you
